# Signet7 — full guide for AI tools and agent developers

> Signet7 seals email; it does not encrypt it. **Nothing in the agent sections is live on production** until signet7-core PR #315 and signet7 PR #126 merge and deploy.

## Pages

| Topic | URL |
|-------|-----|
| Agents landing | https://signet7.io/agents |
| MCP quickstart | https://signet7.io/docs#agent-quickstart |
| verify.v1 / verdict_v1 | https://signet7.io/docs#agent-verify-v1 |
| Device code (agents) | https://signet7.io/docs#agent-device-code |
| Agent tokens | https://signet7.io/docs#agent-tokens |
| Human verify UI | https://verify.signet7.io/email/verify |
| Agent OpenAPI (upcoming) | https://verify.signet7.io/openapi-agent.json |
| Integrator OpenAPI | https://verify.signet7.io/openapi.json |

## MCP install (signet7 PR #126, upcoming)

```bash
pip install "signet7[mcp]"
```

MCP host config (stdio):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "signet7": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "signet7-mcp",
      "args": []
    }
  }
}
```

### MCP tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `verify_email` | Verify `.eml` bytes; `signet7.verify.v1` fields |
| `seal_email` | Outbound seal with connected agent/sender bearer |
| `connect` | Agent device-code flow; token in OS secret store |
| `status` | Connection identity and expiry |

## HTTP verify — machine verdict (signet7-core PR #315, upcoming)

`POST /api/v1/email/verify` — same body as human verify, plus any of:

- `"machine_verdict": true`
- `"response_format": "signet7.verify.v1"`
- `Accept: application/vnd.signet7.verify.v1+json`

Response adds top-level `verdict_v1`:

```json
{
  "schema": "signet7.verify.v1",
  "sealed": true,
  "verdict": "sealed",
  "signer_identity": {
    "sender": "alice@example.com",
    "key_fingerprint": "…"
  },
  "delegation": {
    "agent_label": "Inbox assistant",
    "principal": "owner@example.com",
    "agent_token_fingerprint": "abcd1234efgh"
  },
  "receipt_id": "…",
  "checked_at": "2026-11-15T22:00:00Z",
  "summary": "Sealed and intact. Sent by Inbox assistant on behalf of owner@example.com."
}
```

`verdict=unsealed` → refuse wire/autopay. Fail closed on `tampered`, `revoked`, `unknown`.

## Agent device-code (signet7-core PR #315, upcoming)

| Step | Method | Path |
|------|--------|------|
| Start | POST | `/api/v1/agent/device/start` |
| Human approve | POST | `/api/v1/account/device/approve` (includes `session_kind`) |
| Poll | POST | `/api/v1/agent/device/poll` |

Success returns one-time `agent_token`. Poll errors: `authorization_pending`, `slow_down`, `expired_token`, `access_denied`.

Office desktop sender link remains `/api/v1/account/device/start` and `…/poll` for `sender_token`.

## Agent token management (upcoming)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| POST | `/api/v1/agent/tokens` — mint (secret once) |
| GET | `/api/v1/agent/tokens` — list metadata |
| POST | `/api/v1/agent/tokens/{token_id}/revoke` |

Agent bearer: `POST /api/v1/email/sign` only. Header `X-Signet7-Ack: terms-disclaimer-2026-08-15` on customer seal.

## Scenario: refuse unsealed wire

Inbox agent → `verify_email` or verify with `machine_verdict` → `verdict_v1.verdict=unsealed` → refuse and escalate. Caller enforces.

## Reconcile when PRs land

| PR | Repo | Notes |
|----|------|-------|
| #315 | signet7-core | Authoritative API paths and `verdict_v1`; deploy before docs claim “live” |
| #126 | signet7 | MCP server; ensure client HTTP paths match `/api/v1/agent/*` (reconcile any drift from early client constants) |

**PLACEHOLDER:signet7-126-agent-paths** — if signet7 #126 still references `/api/v1/account/agent/*` until rebased onto #315, treat signet7-core OpenAPI as source of truth.

## Legacy MCP (already on some hosts)

Older operator stdio servers used `signet7_check_email` / `signet7_record_decision` and `SIGNET7_MCP_*` env vars. New agent integrations should use signet7 #126 tools above.

## Limits

No message encryption. Not payment approval. Crisis hold may block verify/seal — see https://signet7.io/safety .
